correctness.rationale: The 9+9 point-line Pappus nonincidence bipartite graph yields disjoint point- and line-side neighborhood components; each is the noncover complex of its nine incidence triples, with nine six-vertex facets. Recomputed independently from the displayed triple system the face vector (9,36,81,108,54,9), binary boundary ranks (8,28,53,45,9), 108 exact line-preserving point permutations, and the signed simplicial Lefschetz trace multiplicities (-2:21,-1:36,1:32,2:18,10:1). The source checker constructs acyclic discrete Morse matchings with one critical vertex and ten critical three-faces, so Forman yields the integral wedge; a color-swapping incidence automorphism identifies the other component. The nonzero homology in degree3 below pure dimension5 rules out shellability.
residual_risks: Independent mod-two ranks alone would not prove integral wedge; the source acyclic Morse matching supplies the homotopy argument.
